name: Spicy Arrabiata Penne
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical pasta recipe proportions (1 lb dry pasta yields ~4 main-dish servings).
Total time is sum of sequential steps: pasta boil ~9 min + sauce ~6 min, with overlap assumed; prep ~5 min added conservatively.
'1 tin' chopped tomatoes classified as 400g standard can (tomatoes only, no added non-vegan ingredients).
Italian seasoning and red chilli flakes assumed spice-only (no hidden allergens or animal products).
'Sprinkling' Parmigiano-Reggiano conservatively classified as dairy cheese (milk allergen present).
Penne rigate classified as wheat-based pasta (gluten and wheat present).
Olive oil, garlic classified as vegan/vegetarian with no allergens.
No fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, sesame, or eggs in listed ingredients.
instructions:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add kosher salt to the boiling water, then add the pasta. Cook according to the package instructions, about 9 minutes.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the olive oil and heat until the oil starts to shimmer. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes, red chile flakes, Italian seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and add the chopped basil.
Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce. Garnish with Parmigiano-Reggiano flakes and more basil and serve warm.

ingredients.name: penne rigate
ingredients.assumptions: Standard dry penne rigate; 1 lb = 454 g dry weight before cooking.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.assumptions: 1/4 cup olive oil weighs approximately 54 g; pure olive oil values used.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.assumptions: 3 average garlic cloves total ~9 g; raw garlic values.

ingredients.name: chopped tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Standard 400 g tin of chopped tomatoes (undrained weight used as typical for recipe).

ingredients.name: red chilli flakes
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp red chilli flakes ≈ 1 g; typical dried chili flake nutrition.

ingredients.name: italian seasoning
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp Italian seasoning ≈ 1 g; typical dried herb blend values.

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.assumptions: 6 fresh basil leaves total ≈ 6 g; fresh basil values.

ingredients.name: Parmigiano-Reggiano
ingredients.assumptions: Sprinkling of Parmigiano-Reggiano estimated at 10 g (about 2 tbsp flakes); typical hard cheese values.
